"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1866 by E.B. Gerber & Carl S. Warner in the Clerks Office of the District Court of the District of Indiana." Includes business directories, statistical table of Huntington County, distance table, views of residential, public, and commercial buildings. Insets: Warren -- New Lancaster -- Markle -- Mahon -- Huntington -- Roanoke -- Mt. Etna -- Antioch -- Kelso. LC copy hand colored and mounted on cloth.
